_說明:
說明頁三層導覽（產品 → 主機平台 → 軟體）的單一來源。gen-guides.mjs 讀這份產生 sensors/

//index.md 與 .md，build.mjs 讀 _build/generated/guides-index.json 做切換列、格子、側欄、首頁選擇器。設計見 _build/guides/DESIGN.md。summaryMatch／colMatch 是 JavaScript regex（不分大小寫），用來從範例頁挑出這個軟體的

、下載表的欄、下載連結。readWith = protocol/snippets/<模組>.mjs 的 bySoftware(sw) 讀法。legacy = 舊頁檔名 → 新頁（'' = 平台頁）；舊頁頁首會加 標記。

tagline.zh: 樂高 SPIKE Prime（黃色主機）與 Robot Inventor（藍綠色主機）
tagline.en: LEGO SPIKE Prime (yellow hub) and Robot Inventor (teal hub)

edition.zh: 買 **SPIKE 版**（樂高 LPF2 接頭），直接插主機 A~F 任一孔，不用電池。SPIKE Prime 教育版（黃色主機）和 Robot Inventor 家用版（藍綠色主機）都能用。
edition.en: Get the **SPIKE edition** (LEGO LPF2 plug) and plug it into any hub port A~F; no battery needed. Works with SPIKE Prime (yellow hub) and Robot Inventor (teal hub).

q.en: The hub does not detect the sensor?

a.zh: 拔掉重插一次，等 2 秒；換一個孔試試。官方 App 會把它顯示成「顏色感應器」，這是正常的。
a.en: Unplug and replug, wait 2 s, try another port. The official app shows it as a colour sensor — that is expected.

q.zh: 可以同時用官方 App 和 Pybricks 嗎？
q.en: Can I use the official app and Pybricks on the same hub?

a.zh: 一次只能裝一種韌體：Pybricks 與 MBC 積木網站用 Pybricks 韌體，官方 App 用樂高原廠韌體；隨時可以用 SPIKE App 換回原廠韌體。
a.en: One firmware at a time: Pybricks and the MBC Blocks website need Pybricks firmware, the official app needs LEGO firmware; you can switch back any time with the SPIKE app.

tagline.zh: 學校最常用；不用換韌體，用顏色感應器積木讀
tagline.en: What most schools use; no firmware change, read with the colour-sensor blocks

colMatch.zh: 樂高官方 App|官方 App

tagline.zh: 中文積木、讀得到全部數值；主機換 Pybricks 韌體
tagline.en: Block coding with every value available; hub runs Pybricks firmware

tagline.zh: 打字寫 Python，最快、最完整；比賽隊伍首選
tagline.en: Type Python: fastest and most complete; the pick of competition teams

tagline.zh: 樂高 MINDSTORMS EV3 主機（RJ12 接頭）

edition.zh: 買 **EV3 版**（RJ12 接頭），插 EV3 的 1~4 號感應器孔。**EV3 先開機再插感應器**；數字不動時拔掉重插一次。
edition.en: Get the **EV3 edition** (RJ12 plug) and plug it into sensor port 1~4. **Power the EV3 on first, then plug the sensor in**; replug if the numbers freeze.

q.zh: EV3 顯示成紅外線感應器？
q.en: The EV3 shows an infrared sensor?

a.zh: 正常：感應器模擬成樂高原廠感應器，用原廠積木就能讀。
a.en: Expected: the sensor emulates a LEGO sensor so the stock blocks can read it.

q.en: A short freeze when switching modes?

a.zh: EV3 每次換模式要等約 0.5 秒。整趟任務盡量只用同一個模式的積木。
a.en: The EV3 needs about 0.5 s per mode change. Stick to one mode during a run.

tagline.zh: 學校電腦教室、WRO 隊伍最常見
tagline.en: Common in school labs and WRO teams

tagline.zh: 跟 SPIKE 一樣的積木，第一次用 EV3 也好上手
tagline.en: Same blocks as SPIKE; easy for first-time EV3 users

tagline.zh: Python 文字程式，讀得到所有模式
tagline.en: Python code with access to every mode

tagline.zh: BASIC 文字程式，已經在用 clev3r 的人
tagline.en: BASIC text code for existing clev3r users

tagline.zh: Arduino UNO、Nano、UNO R4、ESP32，用 I2C 接
tagline.en: Arduino UNO, Nano, UNO R4, ESP32 over I2C

edition.zh: 買 **通用 I2C 版**（4 pin：5V、GND、SDA、SCL），出廠 I2C 位址 `{{addr}}`。UNO／Nano 接 A4（SDA）、A5（SCL）；UNO R4、ESP32 接板子上標 SDA／SCL 的腳。
edition.en: Get the **Universal I2C edition** (4 pins: 5V, GND, SDA, SCL), factory I2C address `{{addr}}`. UNO / Nano: A4 (SDA), A5 (SCL); UNO R4 and ESP32: the pins marked SDA / SCL.

a.zh: 代表模組沒回應：檢查 SDA／SCL 有沒有接反、位址對不對、5V／GND 有沒有接好。
a.en: The module is not answering: check SDA / SCL are not swapped, the address is right and 5V / GND are connected.

a.zh: 可以，每顆位址要不同；同型號用命令 F8 換位址（見通用 I2C 協議）。
a.en: Yes, each needs its own address; re-address identical sensors with command F8 (see the universal I2C protocol).

tagline.zh: 複製範例、上傳就能用；每一行都有中文說明
tagline.en: Copy an example and upload; every line is commented
mBot, Ranger, Orion, MegaPi with mBlock 5 blocks

edition.zh: 買 **MakeBlock 版**（RJ25 接頭），插 mBot／Ranger／Orion／MegaPi 的 RJ25 連接埠；各主板可用哪幾個埠見 [MakeBlock 積木擴展](/makeblock.md)。
edition.en: Get the **MakeBlock edition** (RJ25 plug) and plug it into an RJ25 port of mBot / Ranger / Orion / MegaPi; usable ports per board are listed in [MakeBlock extension](/en/makeblock.md).

a.zh: 確認積木選的連接埠跟實際插的一樣，並且已經用「上傳」模式把程式燒進主板。
a.en: Check the port in the block matches the real port and that the program was uploaded to the board.

q.en: Does the old extension still work?

a.zh: 2026-10 以前出貨的感應器用舊版擴展 v1.0.0；新舊積木不相容，依韌體版本選。
a.en: Sensors shipped before 2026-10 use the legacy v1.0.0 extension; old and new blocks are not compatible.

tagline.zh: 裝 MBC 擴展後用中文積木讀值
tagline.en: Add the MBC extension and read values with blocks

tagline.zh: MATRIX Mini R4 主機，用 MATRIXblock 積木
tagline.en: MATRIX Mini R4 controller with MATRIXblock

edition.zh: 買 **MATRIX 版**，用 MATRIX 原廠 4 pin 感應器線接 Mini R4 的 I2C1 或 I2C2（位址 `0x22`），積木裡選對應的孔。
edition.en: Get the **MATRIX edition** and connect it with the stock MATRIX 4-pin cable to I2C1 or I2C2 of the Mini R4 (address `0x22`); pick that port in the block.

q.zh: 原廠積木和大通道可以一起用嗎？
q.en: Can I mix stock blocks and the big channel?

a.zh: 不行：兩種要裝不同的函式庫檔，一個程式只能選一種。
a.en: No: they need different library files; pick one per program.

longName.zh: MATRIXblock 原廠顏色感應器積木（0x22）

tagline.zh: 不用換函式庫，R~K 七個數就夠用
tagline.en: No library change; seven numbers R~K

tagline.zh: 換函式庫，一包 30 byte 什麼都讀得到
tagline.en: Swap the library and read everything in one 30-byte packet

tagline.zh: 神攝手走串口，用內建攝影機積木讀
tagline.en: The camera talks serial; read it with the built-in camera blocks
micro:bit V1 / V2 with MakeCode blocks

edition.zh: 買 **通用 I2C 版**，接 micro:bit 擴充板的 I2C 孔（SDA = P20、SCL = P19），出廠位址 `{{addr}}`。感應器要 5 V 供電，micro:bit 本身只有 3.3 V，請用有 5 V 輸出的擴充板。
edition.en: Get the **Universal I2C edition** and connect it to the I2C header of a micro:bit breakout (SDA = P20, SCL = P19), factory address `{{addr}}`. The sensor needs 5 V; use a breakout board with a 5 V output.

a.zh: MakeCode「擴充功能」貼上 https://github.com/contactmbcrobot/pxt-mbc-sensors 加入。

tagline.zh: 加入 pxt-mbc-sensors 擴充，積木或 JavaScript 都可以
tagline.en: Add the pxt-mbc-sensors extension; blocks or JavaScript

spike.zh: EXP6 的「Host 通訊線」插 SPIKE Prime 主機任一孔（只支援 SPIKE Prime，不支援 Robot Inventor 與 EV3），另外要接獨立電源給馬達。
spike.en: Plug the EXP6 host cable into any SPIKE Prime port (SPIKE Prime only, not Robot Inventor or EV3) and connect a separate power supply for the motors.

arduino.zh: EXP6 **不能用 I2C** 接 Arduino（主機接頭的隔離晶片只能單向傳送）；改用 **序列埠（UART）**，建議 Arduino UNO R4、Mega 或 ESP32。
arduino.en: The EXP6 **cannot use I2C** with Arduino (the host-port isolator is one-way); use **serial (UART)** instead, ideally with an Arduino UNO R4, Mega or ESP32.

spike.zh: Servo6 插 SPIKE Prime 主機任一孔，舵機接擴充器的 1~6 號孔，另外要接獨立電源給舵機。
spike.en: Plug the Servo6 into any SPIKE Prime port, connect servos to its ports 1~6 and give it a separate power supply.
